content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident (Medical Officer) Overview

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh
11 months only from the date of commencement
Email ( [email protected] ) followed by Walk-In Interview

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification details the following vacancy breakdown for the Addiction Treatment Facility (ATF):

rows.qualification: MD/ DNB – Postgraduate qualification in Psychiatry from NMC recognized institution.
rows.experience: Not specified as mandatory; desirable includes post-doctoral/ fellowship qualifications (PDF/DM in Addiction Psychiatry), at least 2 research publications in PUBMED indexed journals, and research experience in mental health related projects. Experience must be gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected Senior Resident (Medical Officer) receives a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. No other allowance or facilities other than consolidated emoluments/salary are admissible. The appointment is purely temporary on a contract basis for a period of 11 months only from the date of commencement of the contract. It can be terminated by giving one month's notice from either side. Work and conduct are reviewed from time to time, and unsatisfactory performance leads to immediate termination without notice. This appointment does not vest any right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption, or continued contractual renewal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident (Medical Officer)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website and fill in the required details. Upload the soft copies of the filled application form and required documents to the official email ID: [email protected] on or before 07-11-2026 by 5.00 PM. Attend the walk-in interview on 10.11.2026 at the Administration Block, AIIMS Mangalagiri. Report by 8.00 AM for document verification, bringing the filled application form, original certificates, and two (2) sets of self-attested copies of relevant supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Address Proof (any one: Passport, Aadhar card, or Voter ID) Proof of date of birth (any one: 10th mark sheet, 12th mark sheet, or birth certificate) Undergraduate Original Degree certificate Postgraduate Original Degree certificate Registration Certificate (if applicable) Experience certificate (if applicable)

rows.details: Visit the main AIIMS Mangalagiri portal

faq.question: Q1. Is the Senior Resident position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary on a contract basis for a period of 11 months only from the date of commencement of the contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit and how is it calculated?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years, applicable as on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD or DNB postgraduate qualification in Psychiatry from an NMC recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the deadline to submit the application by email?
faq.answer: Candidates must upload the soft copies of the filled application form and required documents on or before 07-11-2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date and venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 10.11.2026 at the Administration Block, AIIMS Mangalagiri, with document verification starting at 8.00 AM.
